BiblicalUsage: Jorai is named once, in 1 Chronicles 5:13. In 1 Chronicles 5:13 we read, "And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jorai teaches me that faithfulness does not need fame to be recorded.
